candidates.name: Cboe official historical downloads
candidates.reason: Official data are downloadable, but website terms limit storage and derivative use without prior written consent.

candidates.name: datasets/finance-vix
candidates.reason: It covers only VIX, not the required bundle. Its README describes the public-domain status as an assumption rather than an authoritative Cboe grant.

candidates.name: vix_utils
candidates.reason: An MIT code license does not grant rights to underlying exchange data downloaded by the code.

candidates.name: vol-regime-prediction
candidates.reason: The project demonstrates a pipeline but does not provide authoritative source-data relicensing for the full required bundle.

candidates.name: Yahoo-based open-source projects
candidates.reason: Open-source client code does not make Yahoo-delivered market data open-licensed.

safe_alternative: Create a separately preregistered round using realized-volatility, downside-semivariance, jump-variation, and CFTC positioning features computed from already-governed R5 returns; these must not be labelled as Cboe implied-volatility equivalents.
